title.tr: Cam cepheli mekânda deck ve basamaklar
title.en: Deck and steps at a glass-fronted venue

alt.tr: Cam cepheli bir mekânın girişinde koyu deck ve basamaklar; yanında nemli beton zemin ve açıkta kalan borular
alt.en: Dark deck and steps at the entrance of a glass-fronted venue, with damp concrete floor and exposed pipes beside them

caption.tr: Deck tahtaları çapraz köşeyle basamaklara dönüyor. Beton alan henüz kaplanmamış, boru ve kablolar zeminde duruyor.
caption.en: The deck boards turn into the steps at a mitred corner. The concrete area has not been covered yet, and pipes and cables lie on the floor.
